name: Connector — PinSocket
description: 915 connector parts sharing PinSocket footprints across multiple pitches (1.27mm, 2.00mm, 2.54mm) and orientations; select by exact footprint, pin count, and pitch.
selection_hints: Match footprint pitch and orientation exactly (1.27mm, 2.00mm, or 2.54mm; horizontal or vertical).
Match pin count/row configuration (e.g. 2x41 vs 1x01) to the mating header.
Prefer tier A entries with confirmed symbol-footprint pairing over tier C bulk entries.
Verify mount type (SMD vs through-hole) matches the intended assembly process.
avoid_when: The mating connector's pitch or pin count is unknown or unconfirmed.
The board requires a non-PinSocket package or land pattern.
Electrical ratings (voltage/current) are required but not stated by the selected part.
The symbol-footprint pairing is unverified or flagged for review.
